recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length portrait of a man in rustic attire leaning against a wooden structure, set against a heavily textured, sepia-toned landscape featuring a large silhouetted tree and rolling hills. The image uses a warm, monochromatic palette with a distressed, vintage paper finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the right edge creates a vertical anchor for the composition.
The silhouetted tree on the left balances the weight of the human figure on the right.
Textured overlays unify the foreground subject with the background landscape.
The central horizontal text block acts as a bridge between the two vertical elements.
coreInvariants: Warm sepia and amber color palette
Heavy distressed/grunge texture across the entire frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male subject is positioned on the far right, occupying approximately one-third of the width, scaled to full height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical wooden post the subject leans against provides the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves down his leaning body, across the central text, and follows the tree silhouette on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the center-left, filled with hazy landscape and texture to allow for legible typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and ochre tones provide the base atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark brown and burnt umber provide shadows and definition in the subject and tree.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep burgundy/maroon used for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between the bright, hazy center and the dark, framed edges.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool tones like blue or green

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with moderate stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Uniform cap height for the primary line
Small caps or reduced scale for the secondary line

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the clearest area of the landscape

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Classic serif for the name paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for the descriptive text.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment to ground the composition

candidateDirections.reason: Classic, authoritative serif feel with sharp terminals.
Traditional elegance that fits the rustic theme.
For the subtitle to provide a clean, modern contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body portrait of a man in a plaid shirt and jeans leaning against a wooden barn wall. The scene is set in a hazy, autumnal field with a large tree silhouette on the left. Apply a heavy sepia-toned, distressed paper texture and a warm amber glow to the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in a large, burgundy serif font in all caps with wide tracking. Position it in the center-left. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a smaller, dark brown sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the texture consistent across the subject and background?
Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Is the text left-aligned and legible against the hazy background?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless integration of the subject into the textured environment.
Ensure the burgundy text color provides enough contrast against the amber background.
Verify the leaning pose looks natural and grounded.
Confirm the tree silhouette doesn't distract from the main subject.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Hazy Landscape + Sepia/Amber Tint + Distressed Overlay + Classical Serif Typography
